info.title: Assessment Helper API
info.description: Peer teaching observations for UTD CS: signup, observer matching, in-app observation record, signatures, anonymous survey, committee dashboard. JSON uses camelCase. A course section is identified by one string, the sectionId ("CS 2117~001~Fall 2026"). Lists that can grow use ?page=&pageSize= and return { pagination }. Errors are { error, code?, details? }. Sign in with POST /api/auth/login (or the NetID mock flow) and send "Authorization: Bearer <token>".
